prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE new individual PNG sticker for a casual mobile sorting game.
The attached original desktop Stickers images are strict style references only, not subjects to copy. Match the same illustrator's visual language and restrained contrast.
SUBJECT is supplied below. Depict only that cohesive object or character and its necessary connected parts. Make the subject immediately recognizable at small size, with a clear simple silhouette.
Hand-painted 2D casual-game illustration: matte color blocks, thin softly irregular tinted contours derived from each local material, finer and lighter internal lines, gently rounded proportions. Use warm middle-light values, restrained saturation, two or three subtly darker same-hue painted shadow planes and a few small light paint patches. Modest illustrative volume; no deep ambient occlusion. Light comes softly from upper left without a dramatic lighting effect. Materials remain distinct through silhouette and hue, not shiny texture.
Limit surface detail to a few broad quiet brush marks, matching the references. Avoid glossy toy or 3D rendering, intense specular shine, heavy black contours, deep dark crevices, dramatic gradients, dense fibers, busy texture, sparkles, or artificially symmetrical ornament. Inanimate objects have no faces unless the subject requests them. Characters have simple gentle facial features, not enormous glassy eyes.
Whole subject centered, all parts fully visible, comfortable clear padding on every side. Natural front or three-quarter view as appropriate. No scene, no floor or cast shadow, no separate decorative objects. A modest white cut-paper margin closely follows the silhouette, much narrower than a thick sticker badge. No black line around the outer white margin.
Output actual transparent-background RGBA PNG. Alpha must be zero outside the white margin. No solid black or white backdrop, no printed checkerboard, no surrounding square, no text, labels, logo, or watermark. Square canvas, target 1024 x 1024. One complete sticker only, not a sheet.
